'''Johan Haneveer Anti-Revolver''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Johan Haneveer]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds78.htm Anti-Revolver], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001215170300/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds78.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Johan Haneveer]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
